title: Tina Brooks as understudy

story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you do some gigs while you were doing – while you were in the play? Did you go away and . . . ?
Yeah, and then I had an understudy . . .

Who was – Tina. Tina and I were making records anyway for Blue Note, for Freddie Redd. So I had – Freddie was the musical director. So I had no problem at when when Freddie said, “Jackie, would you mind if Tina was your understudy.” I said, “Hell no, man. I’d love him to be my” – so I would go off and make these other gigs, and Tina would do the gig for me.
